learn: Ask first: Where will the globe sit: on a desk, a shelf or the floor? (focus 65%). Then: Find out what stops shoppers from buying, and which fix would win them back (focus 5%). Then: Worried the metal will look like plastic (focus 5%). Then: Buying as a gift (focus 5%). Then: Found the store by searching online (focus 5%). Then: Helping kids learn geography (focus 5%). Then: Wants a raised-relief globe (focus 5%). Then: Who is the globe for, and what do they love most? (focus 5%)
